faq.question: Do your VAs know employment law terminology and processes?
faq.answer: Yes. Our employment-focused staff are trained on common practice areas (discrimination, harassment, wage/hour, wrongful termination), EEOC and NLRB workflows, and the language and screening questions relevant to these cases.

faq.question: Can I hire just one role to start?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Most employment firms start with an intake specialist or legal assistant, then scale from there. There are no minimums and no pressure to take more than you need.

faq.question: Will my VA work during my firm's hours?
faq.answer: Yes — all YVA staff work U.S. time zones and align 100% with your firm's schedule. No time zone lag, no missed messages.

faq.question: Is there a contract or long-term commitment?
faq.answer: No lock-ins. Exit anytime, no penalties. Our results should be the reason you stay, not a contract.
